page.layout: One page of text, single column, top to bottom: running head with page number at top; running text paragraph; closing word AMEN; FINIS centred below; then a woodcut ornament and a stamp in the lower part (not text). No margin notes.

main_text.p: Ecclesias laceravit, Orientalésque ab Occidentalibus separavit, & hos omnigenis erroribus servos fecit. Dominus omnipotens, qui veritatis suæ & Ecclesiæ sanguine filii unigeniti redemptæ curam gerens, hisce nostris temporibus partem populi sui è Babylonica captivitate liberam abduxit, opus illud pro misericordia sua infinita perficiat; & suis in libertatem asserendis, vinculisque servitutis tenebrarum & erroris disrumpendis potentem exerat manum, ad regni & imperii Christi stabilimentum, & nominis sui magni gloriam, AMEN.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament and an ink stamp (partly legible, reading roughly "VITT" and "ROM") at the lower centre and right are not text. Show-through from the reverse page is visible in the lower half and was not transcribed. The printed "Digitized by Google" line is a digitiser's banner and was omitted.
